tagline: Sit back to the box, then drive up with the hips.

videos.title: Gym Shorts (How To): The Box Squat

coaching.summary: Squat back and down onto a box set at or just below parallel, sit briefly while staying tight, then drive up off the box.
cues: Set the box so the hips land at or just below parallel.
Touch down under control and stay tight instead of rocking back.
Drive the hips up and keep the chest over the bar as you stand.
